risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (312.3) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 34 days present binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (RSI overbought with golden cross and three white soldiers) combined with extreme fear sentiment (18/100) creates a contrarian buy setup near support (62.29) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI (79.24/73.16) without intermediate trend confirmation (ADX 23.04, EMA 20/50/200 bearish), macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 312.3), earnings binary event in 34 days, and weak volume support (0.62 ratio) make this a high-probability pullback trap rather than swing entry.
